goal: Apply delivery and lesson authoring rules

in_scope: Revise delivery plan and backlog to use concrete draft artifacts as dependencies and separate human approval from readiness.
Track cross-package references and handle affected revisions; reconcile actual coverage and outcomes per module; correct capstone acceptance.
Remove delivery estimates and learner time estimates from active guidance, templates and validator.
out_of_scope: Select delivery order or checkpoint policy; author or execute any content package.
Change the approved outline, source inventory, coverage matrix or approval artifact; publish or merge.

constraints: Preserve stable backlog IDs, topic ownership, source revision and both independent review dimensions.
All generated content remains draft pending explicit human approval. Approval can be batched.
Use the exact approved SDA-v1 baseline, for middle/senior engineers and English learner artifacts.
User authorized applying these changes on 2026-11-11 after deferring scheduling and checkpoint decisions.

definition_of_done.text: Publish the agreed workflow and checks in the delivery plan and backlog, and align active authoring guidance and metadata rules.
Record structural and regression verification with the approved baseline unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.text: Use only concrete draft inputs for readiness, document impact tracking and keep human approval separate. Preserve learner prerequisites and defer execution order and checkpoints.
Each module owns teaching and outcome evidence; final audit reconciles all 473 source topics and Academy outcomes; capstone uses six transfer outcomes.
No delivery forecast or required learning/exercise time metadata in the active authoring contract; lesson validator accepts a complete pair without a duration.
Required repository checks, strict approved course coverage, and backlog identity and dependency integrity pass.
